title: CMRL payoff case: Setback for Pinarayi Vijayan, kin as Kerala HC dismisses pleas to appeal against FIR order
summary: Dismissing pleas by Pinarayi Vijayan, his daughter T. Veena and son-in-law Mohamed Riyas, Division Bench holds that Single Judge’s October 9 order has not affected the applicants’ right to pursue their constitutional or statutory remedies against registration of FIR

title: US startup Reflect Orbital books two launches on Hyderabad-based Skyroot Aerospace’s Vikram rockets
summary: Reflect Orbital builds and operates orbital mirrors to enable controlled lighting without ground infrastructure, to support a variety of customers and applications, from remote search-and-rescue operations to solar farms generating clean power

title: Who is Mary Millben, the U.S. singer at odds with Abhijeet Dipke over CJP funding claims
summary: An African-American singer and actor, Millben enjoys a significant following in India, particularly for her rendition of the national anthem and the devotional song Om Jai Jagdish Hare

title: M.K. Stalin says CM Vijay must visit local grocery shops to understand price rise
summary: He said people, instead of being in a festive mood, were gripped by fear over the rising prices

title: Marco Rubio to skip Delhi, visit Mumbai and Jamnagar next week
summary: His Jamnagar Reliance refinery visit will come a day after U.S. President is expected to take a decision on sanctions on Russian oil imports

title: Anti-CEC protest LIVE | SC directs the preservation of CCTV footage, including in the apex court premises
summary: Supreme Court issues notice to Rahul Gandhi, Digvijaya Singh, Asaduddin Owaisi on petitions against SIR

title: Disproportionate assets’ case: Kerala HC suspends sentence of former DGP Tomin J. Thachankary
summary: In his appeal, Thachankary contended that there were irregularities in the sanction order issued to prosecute him and that the prosecution had miscalculated his rental income, property income, payments made by his relatives, and properties acquired by his wife

title: 151 officer trainees to participate in 78th batch’s Dikshant Parade at National Police Academy
summary: The 78th batch includes 135 IPS probationers and 16 foreign officers from Nepal, Bhutan and the Maldives
